title: Removal Grace Days After the Owner's Decision (Repair Estimates & Appointments Customer Terms)
content:
**Term.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking the owner is given grace days to arrange the vehicle's removal, counted forward from the responsibility date, during which the insurer still answers for the storage:

- a vehicle that arrived on a network-arranged tow, a tow-in charge having been posted on the booking, from farther than the estimate type's tow free radius of service distance gets **3** grace days;
- a vehicle that arrived on a network-arranged tow from within that radius gets **2** grace days;
- any other vehicle gets none.

The service distance is the road distance between the assigned center and the vehicle's location recorded on the booking.

| Estimate type | Tow free radius (miles) |
|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0 |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0 |
| Scheduled Estimate | 0 |
| Mobile Estimate | 0 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 25 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 35 |

**Both sides of the radius** (hypothetical towed vehicles)

| Estimate type | Service distance | Grace days |
|---|---|---|
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 25.0 miles (within) | 2 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 25.1 miles (farther) | 3 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 30.0 miles (within) | 2 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 40.0 miles (farther) | 3 |
| Any type, no tow-in charge ever posted | any | none |
